name: Name
description: Description

name: DATE
description: Converts a provided year, month, and day into a date. Learn more

name: DATEDIF
description: Calculates the number of days, months, or years between two dates. Learn more

name: DATEVALUE
description: Converts a provided date string in a known format to a date value. Learn more

name: DAY
description: Returns the day of the month that a specific date falls on, in numeric format. Learn more

name: DAYS
description: Returns the number of days between two dates. Learn more.

name: DAYS360
description: Returns the difference between two days based on the 360 day year used in some financial interest calculations. Learn more

name: EDATE
description: Returns a date a specified number of months before or after another date. Learn more

name: EOMONTH
description: Returns a date representing the last day of a month which falls a specified number of months before or after another date. Learn more

name: EPOCHTODATE
description: Converts a Unix epoch timestamp in seconds, milliseconds, or microseconds to a datetime in UTC. Learn more

name: HOUR
description: Returns the hour component of a specific time, in numeric format. Learn more

name: ISOWEEKNUM
description: Returns the number of the ISO week of the year where the provided date falls. Learn more

name: MINUTE
description: Returns the minute component of a specific time, in numeric format. Learn more

name: MONTH
description: Returns the month of the year a specific date falls in, in numeric format. Learn more

name: NETWORKDAYS
description: Returns the number of net working days between two provided days. Learn more

name: NETWORKDAYS.INTL
description: Returns the number of net working days between two provided days excluding specified weekend days and holidays. Learn more

name: NOW
description: Returns the current date and time as a date value. Learn more

name: SECOND
description: Returns the second component of a specific time, in numeric format. Learn more

name: TIME
description: Converts a provided hour, minute, and second into a time. Learn more

name: TIMEVALUE
description: Returns the fraction of a 24-hour day the time represents. Learn more

name: TODAY
description: Returns the current date as a date value. Learn more

name: WEEKDAY
description: Returns a number representing the day of the week of the date provided. Learn more

name: WEEKNUM
description: Returns a number representing the week of the year where the provided date falls. Learn more

name: WORKDAY
description: Calculates the end date after a specified number of working days. Learn more

name: WORKDAY.INTL
description: Calculates the date after a specified number of workdays excluding specified weekend days and holidays. Learn more

name: YEAR
description: Returns the year specified by a given date. Learn more

name: YEARFRAC
description: Returns the number of years, including fractional years, between two dates using a specified day count convention. Learn more

name: BIN2DEC
description: Converts a signed binary number to decimal format. Learn more

name: BIN2HEX
description: Converts a signed binary number to signed hexadecimal format. Learn more

name: BIN2OCT
description: Converts a signed binary number to signed octal format. Learn more

name: BITAND
description: Bitwise boolean AND of two numbers. Learn more.

name: BITLSHIFT
description: Shifts the bits of the input a certain number of places to the left. Learn more.

name: BITOR
description: Bitwise boolean OR of 2 numbers. Learn more.

name: BITRSHIFT
description: Shifts the bits of the input a certain number of places to the right. Learn more.

name: BITXOR
description: Bitwise XOR (exclusive OR) of 2 numbers. Learn more.

name: COMPLEX
description: Creates a complex number given real and imaginary coefficients. Learn more

name: DEC2BIN
description: Converts a decimal number to signed binary format. Learn more

name: DEC2HEX
description: Converts a decimal number to signed hexadecimal format. Learn more

name: DEC2OCT
description: Converts a decimal number to signed octal format. Learn more

name: DELTA
description: Compare two numeric values, returning 1 if they're equal. Learn more

name: ERF
description: The ERF function returns the integral of the Gauss error function over an interval of values. Learn more.

name: ERF.PRECISE
description: See ERF

name: GESTEP
description: Returns 1 if the rate is strictly greater than or equal to the provided step value or 0 otherwise. If no step value is provided then the default value of 0 will be used. Learn more.

name: HEX2BIN
description: Converts a signed hexadecimal number to signed binary format. Learn more

name: HEX2DEC
description: Converts a signed hexadecimal number to decimal format. Learn more

name: HEX2OCT
description: Converts a signed hexadecimal number to signed octal format. Learn more

name: IMABS
description: Returns absolute value of a complex number. Learn more

name: IMAGINARY
description: Returns the imaginary coefficient of a complex number. Learn more

name: IMARGUMENT
description: The IMARGUMENT function returns the angle (also known as the argument or \theta) of the given complex number in radians. Learn more.

name: IMCONJUGATE
description: Returns the complex conjugate of a number. Learn more

name: IMCOS
description: The IMCOS function returns the cosine of the given complex number. Learn more.

name: IMCOSH
description: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of the given complex number. For example, a given complex number "x+yi" returns "cosh(x+yi)." Learn more.

name: IMCOT
description: Returns the cotangent of the given complex number. For example, a given complex number "x+yi" returns "cot(x+yi)." Learn more.

name: IMCOTH
description: Returns the hyperbolic cotangent of the given complex number. For example, a given complex number "x+yi" returns "coth(x+yi)." Learn more.

name: IMCSC
description: Returns the cosecant of the given complex number. Learn more.

name: IMCSCH
description: Returns the hyperbolic cosecant of the given complex number. For example, a given complex number "x+yi" returns "csch(x+yi)." Learn more.

name: IMDIV
description: Returns one complex number divided by another. Learn more

name: IMEXP
description: Returns Euler's number, e (~2.718) raised to a complex power. Learn more.

name: IMLOG
description: Returns the logarithm of a complex number for a specified base. Learn more.

name: IMLOG10
description: Returns the logarithm of a complex number with base 10. Learn more.

name: IMLOG2
description: Returns the logarithm of a complex number with base 2. Learn more.

name: IMPRODUCT
description: Returns the result of multiplying a series of complex numbers together. Learn more

name: IMREAL
description: Returns the real coefficient of a complex number. Learn more

name: IMSEC
description: Returns the secant of the given complex number. For example, a given complex number "x+yi" returns "sec(x+yi)." Learn more.

name: IMSECH
description: Returns the hyperbolic secant of the given complex number. For example, a given complex number "x+yi" returns "sech(x+yi)." Learn more.

name: IMSIN
description: Returns the sine of the given complex number. Learn more.

name: IMSINH
description: Returns the hyperbolic sine of the given complex number. For example, a given complex number "x+yi" returns "sinh(x+yi)." Learn more.

name: IMSUB
description: Returns the difference between two complex numbers. Learn more

name: IMSUM
description: Returns the sum of a series of complex numbers. Learn more

name: IMTAN
description: Returns the tangent of the given complex number. Learn more.

name: IMTANH
description: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of the given complex number. For example, a given complex number "x+yi" returns "tanh(x+yi)." Learn more.

name: OCT2BIN
description: Converts a signed octal number to signed binary format. Learn more

name: OCT2DEC
description: Converts a signed octal number to decimal format. Learn more

name: OCT2HEX
description: Converts a signed octal number to signed hexadecimal format. Learn more

name: FILTER
description: Returns a filtered version of the source range, returning only rows or columns which meet the specified conditions. Learn more

name: SORT
description: Sorts the rows of a given array or range by the values in one or more columns. Learn more

name: SORTN
description: Returns the first n items in a data set after performing a sort. Learn more

name: UNIQUE
description: Returns unique rows in the provided source range, discarding duplicates. Rows are returned in the order in which they first appear in the source range. Learn more

name: ACCRINT
syntax: ACCRINT(issue, first_payment, settlement, rate, redemption, frequency, [day_count_convention])
description: Calculates the accrued interest of a security that has periodic payments. Learn more

name: ACCRINTM
description: Calculates the accrued interest of a security that pays interest at maturity. Learn more

name: AMORLINC
syntax: AMORLINC(cost, purchase_date, first_period_end, salvage, period, rate, [basis])
description: Returns the depreciation for an accounting period, or the prorated depreciation if the asset was purchased in the middle of a period. Learn more.

name: COUPDAYBS
description: Calculates the number of days from the first coupon, or interest payment, until settlement. Learn more

name: COUPDAYS
description: Calculates the number of days in the coupon, or interest payment, period that contains the specified settlement date. Learn more

name: COUPDAYSNC
description: Calculates the number of days from the settlement date until the next coupon, or interest payment. Learn more

name: COUPNCD
description: Calculates next coupon, or interest payment, date after the settlement date. Learn more

name: COUPNUM
description: Calculates the number of coupons, or interest payments, between the settlement date and the maturity date of the investment. Learn more

name: COUPPCD
description: Calculates last coupon, or interest payment, date before the settlement date. Learn more

name: CUMIPMT
syntax: CUMIPMT(rate, number_of_periods, present_value, first_period, last_period, end_or_beginning)
description: Calculates the cumulative interest over a range of payment periods for an investment based on constant-amount periodic payments and a constant interest rate. Learn more

name: CUMPRINC
syntax: CUMPRINC(rate, number_of_periods, present_value, first_period, last_period, end_or_beginning)
description: Calculates the cumulative principal paid over a range of payment periods for an investment based on constant-amount periodic payments and a constant interest rate. Learn more

name: DB
description: Calculates the depreciation of an asset for a specified period using the arithmetic declining balance method. Learn more

name: DDB
description: Calculates the depreciation of an asset for a specified period using the double-declining balance method. Learn more

name: DISC
description: Calculates the discount rate of a security based on price. Learn more

name: DOLLARDE
description: Converts a price quotation given as a decimal fraction into a decimal value. Learn more

name: DOLLARFR
description: Converts a price quotation given as a decimal value into a decimal fraction. Learn more

name: DURATION
description: Calculates the number of compounding periods required for an investment of a specified present value appreciating at a given rate to reach a target value. Learn more

name: EFFECT
description: Calculates the annual effective interest rate given the nominal rate and number of compounding periods per year. Learn more

name: FV
description: Calculates the future value of an annuity investment based on constant-amount periodic payments and a constant interest rate. Learn more

name: FVSCHEDULE
description: Calculates the future value of some principal based on a specified series of potentially varying interest rates. Learn more

name: INTRATE
description: Calculates the effective interest rate generated when an investment is purchased at one price and sold at another with no interest or dividends generated by the investment itself. Learn more

name: IPMT
description: Calculates the payment on interest for an investment based on constant-amount periodic payments and a constant interest rate. Learn more

name: IRR
description: Calculates the internal rate of return on an investment based on a series of periodic cash flows. Learn more

name: ISPMT
description: The ISPMT function calculates the interest paid during a particular period of an investment. Learn more.

name: MDURATION
description: Calculates the modified Macaulay duration of a security paying periodic interest, such as a US Treasury Bond, based on expected yield. Learn more

name: MIRR
description: Calculates the modified internal rate of return on an investment based on a series of periodic cash flows and the difference between the interest rate paid on financing versus the return received on reinvested income. Learn more

name: NOMINAL
description: Calculates the annual nominal interest rate given the effective rate and number of compounding periods per year. Learn more

name: NPER
description: Calculates the number of payment periods for an investment based on constant-amount periodic payments and a constant interest rate. Learn more

name: NPV
description: Calculates the net present value of an investment based on a series of periodic cash flows and a discount rate. Learn more

name: PDURATION
description: Returns the number of periods for an investment to reach a specific value at a given rate. Learn more.

name: PMT
description: Calculates the periodic payment for an annuity investment based on constant-amount periodic payments and a constant interest rate. Learn more

name: PPMT
description: Calculates the payment on the principal of an investment based on constant-amount periodic payments and a constant interest rate. Learn more

name: PRICE
syntax: PRICE(settlement, maturity, rate, yield, redemption, frequency, [day_count_convention])
description: Calculates the price of a security paying periodic interest, such as a US Treasury Bond, based on expected yield. Learn more

name: PRICEDISC
description: Calculates the price of a discount (non-interest-bearing) security, based on expected yield. Learn more

name: PRICEMAT
description: Calculates the price of a security paying interest at maturity, based on expected yield. Learn more

name: PV
description: Calculates the present value of an annuity investment based on constant-amount periodic payments and a constant interest rate. Learn more

name: RATE
description: Calculates the interest rate of an annuity investment based on constant-amount periodic payments and the assumption of a constant interest rate. Learn more

name: RECEIVED
description: Calculates the amount received at maturity for an investment in fixed-income securities purchased on a given date. Learn more

name: RRI
description: Returns the interest rate needed for an investment to reach a specific value within a given number of periods. Learn more.

name: SLN
description: Calculates the depreciation of an asset for one period using the straight-line method. Learn more

name: SYD
description: Calculates the depreciation of an asset for a specified period using the sum of years digits method. Learn more

name: TBILLEQ
description: Calculates the equivalent annualized rate of return of a US Treasury Bill based on discount rate. Learn more

name: TBILLPRICE
description: Calculates the price of a US Treasury Bill based on discount rate. Learn more

name: TBILLYIELD
description: Calculates the yield of a US Treasury Bill based on price. Learn more

name: VDB
description: Returns the depreciation of an asset for a particular period (or partial period). Learn more.

name: XIRR
description: Calculates the internal rate of return of an investment based on a specified series of potentially irregularly spaced cash flows. Learn more

name: XNPV
description: Calculates the net present value of an investment based on a specified series of potentially irregularly spaced cash flows and a discount rate. Learn more

name: YIELD
syntax: YIELD(settlement, maturity, rate, price, redemption, frequency, [day_count_convention])
description: Calculates the annual yield of a security paying periodic interest, such as a US Treasury Bond, based on price. Learn more

name: YIELDDISC
description: Calculates the annual yield of a discount (non-interest-bearing) security, based on price. Learn more

name: YIELDMAT
description: Calculates the annual yield of a security paying interest at maturity, based on price. Learn more

name: ARRAYFORMULA
description: Enables the display of values returned from an array formula into multiple rows and/or columns and the use of non-array functions with arrays. Learn more

name: DETECTLANGUAGE
description: Identifies the language used in text within the specified range. Learn more

name: GOOGLEFINANCE
description: Fetches current or historical securities information from Google Finance. Learn more

name: GOOGLETRANSLATE
description: Translates text from one language into another Learn more

name: IMAGE
description: Inserts an image into a cell. Learn more

name: QUERY
description: Runs a Google Visualization API Query Language query across data. Learn more

name: SPARKLINE
description: Creates a miniature chart contained within a single cell. Learn more

name: ERROR.TYPE
description: Returns a number corresponding to the error value in a different cell. Learn more

name: ISBLANK
description: Checks whether the referenced cell is empty. Learn more

name: ISDATE
description: Returns whether a value is a date. Learn more.

name: ISEMAIL
description: Checks whether a value is a valid email address. Learn more

name: ISERR
description: Checks whether a value is an error other than `#N/A`. Learn more

name: ISERROR
description: Checks whether a value is an error. Learn more

name: ISFORMULA
description: Checks whether a formula is in the referenced cell. Learn more

name: ISLOGICAL
description: Checks whether a value is `TRUE` or `FALSE`. Learn more

name: ISNA
description: Checks whether a value is the error `#N/A`. Learn more

name: ISNONTEXT
description: Checks whether a value is non-textual. Learn more

name: ISNUMBER
description: Checks whether a value is a number. Learn more

name: ISREF
description: Checks whether a value is a valid cell reference. Learn more

name: ISTEXT
description: Checks whether a value is text. Learn more

name: N
description: Returns the argument provided as a number. Learn more

name: NA
description: Returns the "value not available" error, `#N/A`. Learn more

name: SHEETS
description: Returns the total number of sheets in the referenced spreadsheet. Learn more about the SHEETS function.

name: TYPE
description: Returns a number associated with the type of data passed into the function. Learn more

name: CELL
description: Returns the requested information about the specified cell. Learn more

name: AND
description: Returns true if all of the provided arguments are logically true, and false if any of the provided arguments are logically false. Learn more

name: FALSE
description: Returns the logical value `FALSE`. Learn more

name: IF
description: Returns one value if a logical expression is `TRUE` and another if it is `FALSE`. Learn more

name: IFERROR
description: Returns the first argument if it is not an error value, otherwise returns the second argument if present, or a blank if the second argument is absent. Learn more

name: IFNA
description: Evaluates a value. If the value is an #N/A error, returns the specified value. Learn more.

name: IFS
description: Evaluates multiple conditions and returns a value that corresponds to the first true condition. Learn more.

name: LAMBDA
description: Creates and returns a custom function with a set of names and a formula_expression that uses them. To calculate the formula_expression, you can call the returned function with as many values as the name declares. Learn more

name: LET
description: Assigns name with the value_expression results and returns the result of the formula_expression. The formula_expression can use the names defined in the scope of the LET function. The value_expressions are evaluated only once in the LET function even if the following value_expressions or the formula_expression use them multiple times. Learn more

name: NOT
description: Returns the opposite of a logical value - `NOT(TRUE)` returns `FALSE`; `NOT(FALSE)` returns `TRUE`. Learn more

name: OR
description: Returns true if any of the provided arguments are logically true, and false if all of the provided arguments are logically false. Learn more

name: SWITCH
syntax: SWITCH(expression, case1, value1, [default or case2, value2], …)
description: Tests an expression against a list of cases and returns the corresponding value of the first matching case, with an optional default value if nothing else is met. Learn more

name: TRUE
description: Returns the logical value `TRUE`. Learn more

name: XOR
description: The XOR function performs an exclusive or of 2 numbers that returns a 1 if the numbers are different, and a 0 otherwise. Learn more.

name: ADDRESS
description: Returns a cell reference as a string. Learn more

name: CHOOSE
description: Returns an element from a list of choices based on index. Learn more

name: COLUMN
description: Returns the column number of a specified cell, with `A=1`. Learn more

name: COLUMNS
description: Returns the number of columns in a specified array or range. Learn more

name: FORMULATEXT
description: Returns the formula as a string. Learn more.

name: GETPIVOTDATA
description: Extracts an aggregated value from a pivot table that corresponds to the specified row and column headings. Learn more

name: HLOOKUP
description: Horizontal lookup. Searches across the first row of a range for a key and returns the value of a specified cell in the column found. Learn more

name: INDEX
description: Returns the content of a cell, specified by row and column offset. Learn more

name: INDIRECT
description: Returns a cell reference specified by a string. Learn more

name: LOOKUP
description: Looks through a row or column for a key and returns the value of the cell in a result range located in the same position as the search row or column. Learn more

name: MATCH
description: Returns the relative position of an item in a range that matches a specified value. Learn more

name: OFFSET
description: Returns a range reference shifted a specified number of rows and columns from a starting cell reference. Learn more

name: ROW
description: Returns the row number of a specified cell. Learn more

name: ROWS
description: Returns the number of rows in a specified array or range. Learn more

name: SHEET
description: Returns the sheet number of the specified sheet or other reference. Learn more about the SHEET function.

name: VLOOKUP
description: Vertical lookup. Searches down the first column of a range for a key and returns the value of a specified cell in the row found. Learn more

name: XLOOKUP
description: Returns the values in the result range based on the position where a match was found in the lookup range. If no match is found, it returns the closest match. Learn more

name: ABS
description: Returns the absolute value of a number. Learn more

name: ACOS
description: Returns the inverse cosine of a value, in radians. Learn more

name: ACOSH
description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a number. Learn more

name: ACOT
description: Returns the inverse cotangent of a value, in radians. Learn more.

name: ACOTH
description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cotangent of a value, in radians. Must not be between -1 and 1, inclusive. Learn more.

name: ASIN
description: Returns the inverse sine of a value, in radians. Learn more

name: ASINH
description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine of a number. Learn more

name: ATAN
description: Returns the inverse tangent of a value, in radians. Learn more

name: ATAN2
description: Returns the angle between the x-axis and a line segment from the origin (0,0) to specified coordinate pair (`x`,`y`), in radians. Learn more

name: ATANH
description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a number. Learn more

name: BASE
description: Converts a number into a text representation in another base, for example, base 2 for binary. Learn more.

name: CEILING
description: Rounds a number up to the nearest integer multiple of specified significance. Learn more

name: CEILING.MATH
description: Rounds a number up to the nearest integer multiple of specified significance, with negative numbers rounding toward or away from 0 depending on the mode. Learn more.

name: CEILING.PRECISE
description: Rounds a number up to the nearest integer multiple of specified significance. If the number is positive or negative, it is rounded up. Learn more.

name: COMBIN
description: Returns the number of ways to choose some number of objects from a pool of a given size of objects. Learn more

name: COMBINA
description: Returns the number of ways to choose some number of objects from a pool of a given size of objects, including ways that choose the same object multiple times. Learn more.

name: COS
description: Returns the cosine of an angle provided in radians. Learn more

name: COSH
description: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of any real number. Learn more

name: COT
description: Cotangent of an angle provided in radians. Learn more.

name: COTH
description: Returns the hyperbolic cotangent of any real number. Learn more.

name: COUNTBLANK
description: Returns the number of empty cells in a given range. Learn more

name: COUNTIF
description: Returns a conditional count across a range. Learn more

name: COUNTIFS
description: Returns the count of a range depending on multiple criteria. Learn more

name: COUNTUNIQUE
description: Counts the number of unique values in a list of specified values and ranges. Learn more

name: CSC
description: Returns the cosecant of an angle provided in radians. Learn more.

name: CSCH
description: The CSCH function returns the hyperbolic cosecant of any real number. Learn more.

name: DECIMAL
description: The DECIMAL function converts the text representation of a number in another base, to base 10 (decimal). Learn more.

name: DEGREES
description: Converts an angle value in radians to degrees. Learn more

name: ERFC
description: Returns the complementary Gauss error function of a value. Learn more

name: ERFC.PRECISE
description: See ERFC

name: EVEN
description: Rounds a number up to the nearest even integer. Learn more

name: EXP
description: Returns Euler's number, e (~2.718) raised to a power. Learn more

name: FACT
description: Returns the factorial of a number. Learn more

name: FACTDOUBLE
description: Returns the "double factorial" of a number. Learn more

name: FLOOR
description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer multiple of specified significance. Learn more

name: FLOOR.MATH
description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer multiple of specified significance, with negative numbers rounding toward or away from 0 depending on the mode. Learn more.

name: FLOOR.PRECISE
description: The FLOOR.PRECISE function rounds a number down to the nearest integer or multiple of specified significance. Learn more.

name: GAMMALN
description: Returns the the logarithm of a specified Gamma function, base e (Euler's number). Learn more

name: GAMMALN.PRECISE
description: See GAMMALN

name: GCD
description: Returns the greatest common divisor of one or more integers. Learn more

name: IMLN
description: Returns the logarithm of a complex number, base e (Euler's number). Learn more

name: IMPOWER
description: Returns a complex number raised to a power. Learn more

name: IMSQRT
description: Computes the square root of a complex number. Learn more

name: INT
description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer that is less than or equal to it. Learn more

name: ISEVEN
description: Checks whether the provided value is even. Learn more

name: ISO.CEILING
description: See CEILING.PRECISE

name: ISODD
description: Checks whether the provided value is odd. Learn more

name: LCM
description: Returns the least common multiple of one or more integers. Learn more

name: LN
description: Returns the the logarithm of a number, base e (Euler's number). Learn more

name: LOG
description: Returns the the logarithm of a number given a base. Learn more

name: LOG10
description: Returns the the logarithm of a number, base 10. Learn more

name: MOD
description: Returns the result of the modulo operator, the remainder after a division operation. Learn more

name: MROUND
description: Rounds one number to the nearest integer multiple of another. Learn more

name: MULTINOMIAL
description: Returns the factorial of the sum of values divided by the product of the values' factorials. Learn more

name: MUNIT
description: Returns a unit matrix of size dimension x dimension. Learn more.

name: ODD
description: Rounds a number up to the nearest odd integer. Learn more

name: PI
description: Returns the value of Pi to 14 decimal places. Learn more

name: POWER
description: Returns a number raised to a power. Learn more

name: PRODUCT
description: Returns the result of multiplying a series of numbers together. Learn more

name: QUOTIENT
description: Returns one number divided by another. Learn more

name: RADIANS
description: Converts an angle value in degrees to radians. Learn more

name: RAND
description: Returns a random number between 0 inclusive and 1 exclusive. Learn more

name: RANDARRAY
description: Generates an array of random numbers between 0 and 1. Learn more.

name: RANDBETWEEN
description: Returns a uniformly random integer between two values, inclusive. Learn more

name: ROUND
description: Rounds a number to a certain number of decimal places according to standard rules. Learn more

name: ROUNDDOWN
description: Rounds a number to a certain number of decimal places, always rounding down to the next valid increment. Learn more

name: ROUNDUP
description: Rounds a number to a certain number of decimal places, always rounding up to the next valid increment. Learn more

name: SEC
description: The SEC function returns the secant of an angle, measured in radians. Learn more.

name: SECH
description: The SECH function returns the hyperbolic secant of an angle. Learn more

name: SEQUENCE
description: Returns an array of sequential numbers, such as 1, 2, 3, 4. Learn more.

name: SERIESSUM
description: Given parameters x, n, m, and a, returns the power series sum a1xn + a2x(n+m) + ... + aix(n+(i-1)m), where i is the number of entries in range `a`. Learn more

name: SIGN
description: Given an input number, returns `-1` if it is negative, `1` if positive, and `0` if it is zero. Learn more

name: SIN
description: Returns the sine of an angle provided in radians. Learn more

name: SINH
description: Returns the hyperbolic sine of any real number. Learn more

name: SQRT
description: Returns the positive square root of a positive number. Learn more

name: SQRTPI
description: Returns the positive square root of the product of Pi and the given positive number. Learn more

name: SUBTOTAL
description: Returns a subtotal for a vertical range of cells using a specified aggregation function. Learn more

name: SUM
description: Returns the sum of a series of numbers and/or cells. Learn more

name: SUMIF
description: Returns a conditional sum across a range. Learn more

name: SUMIFS
description: Returns the sum of a range depending on multiple criteria. Learn more

name: SUMSQ
description: Returns the sum of the squares of a series of numbers and/or cells. Learn more

name: TAN
description: Returns the tangent of an angle provided in radians. Learn more

name: TANH
description: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of any real number. Learn more

name: TRUNC
description: Truncates a number to a certain number of significant digits by omitting less significant digits. Learn more

name: ADD
